r15-codes.title: A timesheet code for tickets
body: You asked why tickets have no default code. Codes come from three places today: a code on the **project** (Customize → Projects), a code per **category** (Customize → Timesheet), or a code on the entry itself, which the app stores but has nowhere to set. Tray tickets roll up into a "Tickets" entry with no project and no category, so none of those reach them and they always show as **Unassigned** on the Timesheet.
Three small fixes, shown below. They only change which code a line gets; your hours and entries stay as they are.
bullets: **A code for tickets:** one new line at the top of Customize → Timesheet. Tickets with a project still use the project's code.
**A code on each entry:** its details show which code it gets and where from, and you can pick a different one for just that entry.
**Pick a code on the Timesheet:** an Unassigned line gets a button right where you notice it. On the Tickets line it can set the tickets code for good.
